program: Minnesota Health Care Programs (Medical Assistance / MinnesotaCare) fee-for-service
document_title: Minnesota Health Care Programs Fee Schedule - CURRENT FEE SCHEDULE AS OF 10/12/2026
notes: Value used = 'TOTAL ALLOW' column (base fee schedule). IMPORTANT: the document's header states 'For all dental services provided on or after 01/01/22, an additional 98% must be added to the fee schedule total amount to determine the total reimbursement amount' - the fees recorded here are the listed base amounts WITHOUT that +98% add-on (actual payment is approx. base x 1.98; not computed here). Header also says exam/x-ray fees for children under 21 are based on 85% of 1999 median charge under factor code Q, but no separate Q-factor rows exist in the file for these codes, so one value per code ('all'). by_report = codes listed with FACT CODE 3 ('general price by report') and no total allowable (crowns D2740-D2790, D2962, implants, D6245, D6740, D7953). 'Inclusion on this report does not imply coverage' (adult coverage limits per MHCP Provider Manual). Fees for D7xxx codes: the 'APC/ASC ALLOW' column (facility) was ignored. Many dental members are in managed care (PMAP) - rates there may differ. Document date: sheet header 'AS OF 10/12/2026' (file modified 2026-10-13).
notes_2024: No archived mid-2024 edition could be retrieved (mn.gov serves only the current file; web.archive.org was rate-limited/offline during this run). Values are derived from the CURRENT schedule (AS OF 10/12/2026) using its 'EFF DATE' column, which the document defines as 'the effective date of the current TOTAL ALLOWABLE': only codes whose current total allowable has an effective date on or before 2024-07-01 are included (that amount was therefore already in force on 2024-07-01). Excluded because the current amount took effect after 2024-07-01 (2024 value unknown): D6010(eff 2025-01-01), D7140(eff 2026-10-01), D7210(eff 2026-10-01), D7220(eff 2026-10-01), D7230(eff 2026-10-01), D7240(eff 2026-10-01), D7241(eff 2026-10-01), D7250(eff 2026-10-01). Base amounts only. +98% add-on: the current header says the additional 98% applies to all dental services provided on or after 01/01/22, and the MHCP Provider Manual 'Payment Methodology - Non-Hospital' page lists '98 percent for dental services MA and MinnesotaCare members (January 2022)', so the add-on applied in 2024 as well (actual 2024 payment approx. base x 1.98). D8070/D8080/D8090 = 73.09 each (FACT CODE 1, eff 2000-01-01): the unit basis (per visit / per month / per case) is NOT stated in the fee schedule, and the MHCP dental manual pages were blocked by a bot-protection captcha, so it could not be verified; 73.09 is clearly not a full-case comprehensive orthodontic fee - treat as unverified.
